name: Vivekanandan KS
title: Nix for SRE: The Zero-drift Hermetic infrastructure for Determinism
abstract: Nix is a crucial technology for a wide range of domain in IT world, one of the important domain is SRE. In this talk I aim to shift the audience's thinking towards SRE and how we improve the workflow. I'll explain the big loopholes in the current industry standards and explain it's hidden technical debt in energy, time, cost etc I'll quickly introduce Nix and explain how it fits in the SRE domain. I'll explain the mental modal of proactive reliability vs passive reliability. I'll also explain why determinism is crucial for SRE. The talk will also give an idea of how Nix + AI + SRE is way better than just using AI + SRE. In short: Determinism is more important than one might ever think which traditional approaches tries their best, but nothing ever came close to what Nix does in the history of tech. Key takeaways: What typical and AI first SRE lacks How Nix makes infra easy to predict and gives true determinism How Nix provides sovereignty for SRE How Nix removes the complexity of DevOps, SRE workflows Why it's better to use Nix + AI instead of using AI for SRE etc Change in mental model of how u think about the whole SDLC process Note: Though the topic and description may sound too technical, it actually isnt. It's just a different way of thinking. So this talk is for everyone from beginners to veterans.
bio: A passionate Linux and Nix/NixOS guy who thrives on learning, exploring, and implementing open-source solutions. Driven by a love for DevOps and solving complex technical problems, he is a creative at heart - and a bassist on hiatus - who loves good stories, music, and anime.
